title: PACE-PANCREAS_Patient specific Contrast Enhancement timing for pancreatic evaluation in Computer Tomography
summary: To compare the contrast and assessability of the pancreas in a fixed-trigger-delay cohort with a historical fixed-trigger-delay cohort for bolus-tracking contrast.

interventions.name: A total of approximately 100 patients with suspected pancreatic cavity involvement will be included using bolus tracking with individualized trigger delay. The quality of contrast and assessment of the pancreas will be compared with a historical control (n=100; suitably matched) with fixed trigger d
historical control group as an additional arm to compare the new method of individual trigger delay.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Indication for performing CTA of the pancreas.
Age-adjusted normal serum creatinine or creatinine clearance > 30 ml / min / 1.73 m2 for safe contrast administration
Exclusion criteria:
Contraindication to the performance of computed tomography
